mapper.select: SELECT it.id, it.user_id, it.track_time, it.mileage, it.duration, it.area, it.status, it.points, it.reserve1, it.reserve2, it.creator, it.updater, it.create_time, it.update_time, iu.name AS user_name FROM inspect_track it LEFT JOIN inspect_user iu ON it.user_id = iu.id WHERE it.id = #{id} AND it.deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(it.mileage), 0) AS total_mileage, COALESCE(SUM(it.duration), 0) AS total_duration FROM inspect_track it WHERE it.deleted = 0
AND it.track_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.timeRange[0]} AND #{reqVO.timeRange[1]}
